hint.COMPLETE: Sprint complete! Run `deckent retro` to read retrospective
hint.PLAN: Run `deckent start` to begin the sprint
hint.IDLE: Run `deckent plan` to plan a sprint
status.no_active_sprint: No active sprint. Run `deckent start` first.
plan.ai_fallback: AI planner returned fewer tasks than expected, falling back to structured planning.
start.sandbox_not_implemented: Sandbox mode not yet implemented. Running normally.
start.watch_ignored_dry_run: Note: --watch ignored in dry-run mode (no workers spawned).
start.watch_window_created: Watch window created. Attach with: tmux attach -t deckent:watch
start.watch_no_tmux: Note: --watch requires an active tmux session. Skipping watch setup.
init.next_step_directives: 1. Edit DIRECTIVES.md with your project goals
init.next_step_start: 2. Run `deckent start` to begin your first sprint
init.already_initialized: Deckent already initialized. Use --force to reinitialize.
cleanup.complete: Cleanup complete. Removed artifacts for {count} tasks.
spawn.max_workers_reached: Max workers ({max}) already running. Task queued.
attach.no_active_session: No active session. Run `deckent start` first.
error.directives_missing: DIRECTIVES.md not found. Run `deckent init` first.
error.sprint_in_progress: Sprint {id} already in progress. Use `deckent status` to check.
error.model_not_available: Model {model} not available for your subscription.
error.lock_conflict: Lock conflict: {file} is locked by worker {worker}.
error.boundary_violation: Scope boundary violation: {file} is outside allowed directories.
archive_debt.nothing_to_archive: No resolved debt items to archive.
archive_debt.archived: Archived {count} resolved debt items. {remaining} items remaining.
error.tmux_not_found: tmux not found. Install: brew install tmux (macOS) / sudo apt install tmux (Linux). Or use spawn_backend: "subprocess" in config.
error.claude_not_found: Claude CLI not found. Install: npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code
error.no_directives: DIRECTIVES.md not found. Create it with sprint goals, or run: deckent init
error.config_invalid: Configuration is invalid. Run: deckent doctor to diagnose
error.scope_violation: Worker exceeded assigned scope. Check task scope boundaries.
error.lock_conflict: Another worker holds the lock. Wait or run: deckent cleanup
error.usage_exceeded: Usage threshold reached. Sprint has been auto-paused.
error.build_failed: Build failed. Run: tsc --noEmit to check for errors.
error.git_not_found: git not found. Install git to use deckent.
error.node_version_low: Node.js version too low. Upgrade to >=18.
